consequence.statement: The cilium_node_connectivity_status metric keeps working in 1.17.0 but is deprecated; environments whose dashboards or alerts read it should switch to cilium_node_health_connectivity_status, as the old metric is slated for removal in a later release.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerting rules and other metric consumers to use cilium_node_health_connectivity_status instead of cilium_node_connectivity_status.

assertion.statement: The cilium_node_connectivity_status metric is deprecated in Cilium 1.17.0 in favor of the new cilium_node_health_connectivity_status metric.
